I intend PROPOSED private native capture passed into root Context BEFORE first effect, propagated to fibers, capturing raw registered disposer results before logging plus existing F3 direct Agent/late handle cleanup results; one root control store/ref channel, no log parsing or stock semantics changes. To pin exact bootstrap callsite rather than guess source paths, please provide and explicitly permit the exact immutable R app-boot owning source path containing boot and root new Context call, with its export/re-export path if needed; source-body analysis remains mine, parent need only discover source filenames/locator or grant bounded public immutable tree-path discovery. This adds no editable path or source execution authority; future source/build inventory counts will include actual boot/context/fiber capture targets and coherent F1/F3/F5 estimates, each <=25/2000 or resplit before future mutation. All other full method constraints/counters unchanged; no manufactured API or fallback if source cannot be established.
